pr.title: Color selected panel labels instead of inverting rows
pr.head: 38c6ad71a6bb820afeec1ca6c8674271fe044b8a

summary: The Projector console shows a session list above the selected session’s pull requests and inbox items. Keyboard focus tells you which row, answer, or action Enter will activate.

This change highlights the focused label in the selected session name’s color and makes it bold. Other parts of a row keep their status colors and normal background, so moving focus does not change how a conflict, title, or age looks.

cards.title: What receives focus styling
cards.html:
• Rows and answer options: their first text part receives the focus style.
  • Inline actions: only the action at Line.lit receives it.
  • Other text: status words, titles, and ages keep their own styles. A drag selection can still reverse the selected text.

cards.title: Review evidence
cards.html: The exact head has a clean review with no findings. The configured gate, 111 focused Python tests, and 270 hook tests passed. Rendering tests cover dark, light, eight-color, and monochrome terminals; no physical terminal display or live provider session was exercised.

groups.title: Preserve the meaning of row colors
groups.kicker: The shared renderer highlights the focused label
intro: Each console line contains text parts with separate styles. A pull request row, for example, keeps its label separate from its status and title. The renderer now applies focus styling to the first part of a selected row, rather than inverting every part.

An inline action already identifies its focused part with lit. That part uses the same color and bold styling. Bold also distinguishes focus when the label already has the focus color or colors are disabled.

files.note: Defines focused line parts and applies their style before clipping and drag-selection rendering.

checks.text: Traced every selected Line producer and the managed-console subclass. Focus reuses the selected session name’s suggestion style; text, click targets, clipping, and drag-selection spans stay unchanged. All 111 focused console tests passed.

files.note: Describes label-only color, the bold fallback, and the existing option/action marker.

checks.text: The navigation contract is unchanged: Enter still activates the focused row, option, or action. This paragraph describes the visual cue for that same focus.

groups.title: Check focus without altering other text
groups.kicker: Behavioral rendering tests cover palette and navigation cases
intro: The tests capture the attributes used to draw each piece of text. They move focus away from a pull request and through an inbox subject, answer options, and actions, then compare the resulting attributes.

A table covers dark, light, eight-color, and monochrome terminals. It checks that the focused label stays distinguishable while the conflict status and pull request title retain their original styling.

files.note: Adds focus-attribute regressions while preserving the existing foreground-color checks.

checks.text: Ran tests.test_console and tests.test_agent_console: all 111 tests passed. The focused and unfocused pull request renderings preserve status/title attributes, and the inbox regression verifies that focus leaves the age and inactive controls unchanged.
